steps.content: She studies you for a moment, wearing that usual smile of hers.

steps.speaker: Yingying
steps.content: Oh... so Yugu sent you in here. I almost forgot, you have quite a few "caring ladies" helping you out there.

steps.speaker: Yingying
steps.content: Silly, becoming a character in her stories isn't something to celebrate. She always keeps tabs on her favors. You may get yourself into trouble without even knowing.

steps.speaker: Yingying
steps.content: Come now, don't look so sad. The fete should be a place of joy.

steps.speaker: Yingying
steps.content: Since she's the one who sent you here, you should know this is just another story she wrote. She has a thing for tearjerkers—crafting tales of tragic love between the living and the dead, all to steal your tears. Don't let yourself fall for it.
She reaches out to rub your face, but inadvertently reveals the spreading corruption marks on her arm. Instantly, she pulls her hand back and takes half a step away.

steps.speaker: Yingying
steps.content: ...This isn't my true self, just a projection. Don't worry about it.

steps.speaker: Option
options: Then where is the real you?

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Can you leave this place?

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: The fete was over long ago—a hundred years ago. Let's go for a walk outside instead. I'll show you the way.
She watches you in silence.

steps.speaker: Yingying
steps.content: ...Are you trying to save me, sweetheart?

steps.speaker: Yingying
steps.content: Can't bear to let me go? Have I captured your heart? Or do you just pity me? You've always been so kind-hearted, unable to watch others suffer, always trying to help everyone you meet.

steps.speaker: Yingying & All
steps.content: But I'm not the only one here. Who do you want to save? Who will you save? Who will you save?
A massive surge of resentment suddenly erupts from within her, howling with desire for your life force. You instinctively take a step back, but in that same instant, it all vanishes without a trace.
Then, just like how she used to tease you, she bursts into laughter at your reaction.

steps.speaker: Yingying
steps.content: Scared, aren't you? This is exactly why I didn't want you to come back. I can't keep up my old charming self anymore.

steps.speaker: %u
steps.content: Even beneath a spirit's guise beats a human heart. I know who you really are, and I believe in the kindness you've shown us.

steps.speaker: Yingying
steps.content: A single thought can make a saint or demon. And me? I harbor quite a bit of resentment, you know.

A withered vine rises from below, lifting your chin to make you look into her eyes. Only then do you realize that those eyes, which once reflected the warm lights of countless homes, now harbor an unfathomable darkness in their depths.
That darkness looms ominously, a stagnant void akin to something long deceased, decaying over the ages, sealing away any decipherable hint of her true intentions.

steps.speaker: Yingying
steps.content: You enjoyed the fete, did you, sweetheart? With all the fun... was there a moment when all your burdens slipped away? Was there a fleeting second when you wished such happiness could last forever?

steps.speaker: Yingying
steps.content: ...That's what we thought too, on the day the shooting star fell.

steps.speaker: Yingying
steps.content: No matter how tough life gets, people keep on moving forward. They've faced the darkest times, always finding something to hope for... After trying so hard just to stay alive, why must they still be let down?
As she speaks, she narrows her eyes in another smile.

steps.speaker: Yingying
steps.content: I'm just a simple soul who loves happy endings. I hope those who made wishes here will come back next year with hearts full of joy. If heaven won't watch over them... then I will.

steps.speaker: Yingying
steps.content: Everyone has entrusted their wishes to me. As long as the fete continues, there's nothing I won't do—nothing I haven't already done... Would you like to hear about another fete? The story is even more fascinating than Yugu's tales.

steps.speaker: Yingying
steps.content: No? Well, that's fine. You're too kind-hearted—risking your life to come back for even a wicked spirit like me, trying to save me.

steps.speaker: Yingying
steps.content: So, if I do a few more things in your homeland, you'll forgive me, right? After all, you feel so sorry for us... You just can't bring yourself to leave us behind.
The vine caresses your chin with deceptive gentleness, all the while draining away your strength, depleting your energy bit by bit.

She is still chuckling, yet now more "human" voices begin to emerge within her laughter—twisted, covetous voices that pour directly into your mind. This signals the impending collapse of the collective consciousness, more terrifying than any fiend in Yugu's tales.
But...

steps.speaker: Option
options: You're pretty bad at making up stories, Yingying.

steps.speaker: %u
steps.content: You wanted to cover for the evil, even play evil yourself, yet you couldn't bring yourself to crush your listeners' hearts, always leaving a glimmer of hope. Why don't you let me take over the story instead...

steps.speaker: %u
steps.content: I've already heard the original story of the fete from the taleteller...
[Cutaway]

steps.speaker: Yugu
steps.content: Unable to bear the endless torment, the maiden succumbed to madness. To sustain everyone's obsession, she first offered her own Qi, then began luring travelers to steal theirs. Again and again, year after year, she perpetuated this fete that existed only in her illusory dream.

steps.speaker: Yugu
steps.content: But the fete never truly revived as she wished. Every single time, on the third day, the ominous star of death would fall without fail, bringing devastation upon Bloomfete Street, leaving her as the sole survivor—everyone else perished, all their wishes shattering the very moment they were made... It took her a long time to understand the reason.
[Cutaway]

steps.speaker: %u
steps.content: You made wish after wish to restore the fete, to save everyone. But Yingying... when the fete began anew each time, when the locals appeared before you—did you truly feel at peace? Did you really believe your wish had come true?

steps.speaker: %u
steps.content: Or maybe witnessing them only reminded you of your repeated failures—of how powerless you were to stop that falling star?

steps.speaker: %u
steps.content: Mania has never granted any wishes. It's born from corrupted hearts, only reflecting the deepest truths within a heart into reality.

steps.speaker: %u
steps.content: It can do nothing but repeat the nightmare you can't escape, endlessly churning that hatred and despair into an eternal curse, growing and spreading—until it spirals beyond your control and devours you whole.

steps.speaker: %u
steps.content: ...You've known it all along, have you? That's why you keep telling me to let go of my past.
[Cutaway]

steps.speaker: Yugu
steps.content: The maiden, consumed by dark powers, wandered the world in her madness, leaving chaos in her wake. Years passed until one day, she attacked a taleteller in search of ancient lore. From this taleteller, she heard a new story about her cherished fete...

steps.speaker: Yugu
steps.content: In that one, there was no divine wisteria standing guard over the people—only an undying demonic tree. No warm-hearted locals—only bloodthirsty fiends. Gone was the memory of that jubilant fete where visitors from far and wide celebrated the New Year together. All that remained was a notorious street of haunting ghosts.

steps.speaker: Yugu
steps.content: The past she desperately sought to revive was already dead and gone, and what killed it was her own obsession. Only this truth was painful enough to wake her from her delusion.

steps.speaker: Yugu
steps.content: The anguish weighed heavily upon her, filling her with remorse, but what worth was the repentance of a single soul? She could no longer control the malevolence she had stirred. This accursed festival would roam as it pleases, beyond her sway.
[Cutaway]
In the original ending of the tale, the flower spirit was sealed away in eternal slumber, and with her, the rampaging fete would never awaken again.

—This was the ending she asked Yugu to write. The flower spirit allowed Yugu to seal her into the story. Sacrificing her own fate, she sought to borrow the taleteller's power to reshape the story, break the twisted curse, and grant everyone their final peace.
But of all people, she had to encounter such a cruel soul... and of all places, the taleteller had to bring her to DisCity...
[Cutaway]

steps.speaker: Yugu
steps.content: Come to think of it... the one who awakened her, the one destined to find her... wouldn't that be you, after all?

steps.speaker: Yugu
steps.content: Heheh... I should be the one thanking you...

steps.speaker: Yugu
steps.content: Such a tragic, such a lovely tale. I simply cannot bear to let it end here.
[Scene Change]
Yingying gazes at you. After a long while, she lets out a deep sigh.

steps.speaker: Yingying
steps.content: You're too kind-hearted... No wonder you're always so tired...

steps.speaker: Yingying
steps.content: Don't overthink it, sweetheart. These are just stories, no matter which version you hear... Stories belong to the past, to other people.

steps.speaker: Yingying
steps.content: Truth or lies, reality or illusion—none of that matters anymore. It's all in the past. Once a story ends, we must keep moving forward... What matters is the here and now.
Her smile, though no longer as bright as before, carries a gentle warmth.
—Tinged with weariness.

steps.speaker: Yingying
steps.content: There's Eastia, standing strong through the calamities, myths freshly woven by scholars, the little lion dancer journeying from Goldionville across the ocean, and... the city and people you can't bear to leave behind regardless of the burdens you shoulder.

steps.speaker: Yingying
steps.content: Don't let the sorrows of the past weigh you down. The path ahead will only grow rougher. You must learn to ease your load, so why not start by letting go of those stories that belong to the past, to others?

steps.speaker: Yingying
steps.content: The New Year has come. I have my street to watch over, and you... should go back to protect your city.
She raises her hand slightly, and you immediately know what she's about to do.

steps.speaker: Yingying
steps.content: Nope.

A tremendous force strikes you—and at the same time, her smile grows ever more radiant, devoid of all traces of sorrow as if they had never been there. For the guardian of the fete forever resides in joy and anticipation.

steps.speaker: Yingying
steps.content: Before you stands the wisteria flower spirit—the bearer of a millennium-old faith and the obsessions of countless souls, wandering the world for centuries! I am every unfulfilled wish, the very source of all corruption.

steps.speaker: Yingying
steps.content: Be decisive, great hero of DisCity—there's no time for doubt when vanquishing evil spirits. The wisteria did not fulfill my wish, but you, sweetheart, you can.
At last, the Mania flames are unleashed, lapping at her body until she becomes one with the blazing wisteria behind her.
Upon the impact, the vines release their grip. The ground beneath your feet crumbles away, and you plummet rapidly into the story's rift.

steps.speaker: Yingying
steps.content: Thank you for accompanying me to the fete... for helping me relive what I truly missed... It's been so long...

steps.speaker: Yingying
steps.content: Let it go back to the best days, and show me a happy ending.
The last thing you see is the massive tree crashing down with a thunderous rumble.
[Transition] Infirmary or Taleteller's Blue Hall

steps.speaker: Yugu
steps.content: Birth, aging, sickness, and death are but norms of life, not to mention the pains of facing what we despise, parting from what we cherish, and yearning for what we cannot have. If one fails to find beauty within cruelty and suffering, how are they to navigate this harsh world? Just like her...

steps.speaker: Yugu
steps.content: However, what must end shall end, just as every tale must reach its final chapter.

steps.speaker: Yugu
steps.content: That look in your eyes tells me you are prepared to take on the role of protagonist and bring this tragedy to its end in my stead, are you not?

steps.speaker: Yugu
steps.content: Welcome back, Chief.

steps.speaker: Yugu
steps.content: Have you attained your desire? Or perhaps...

steps.speaker: Yugu
steps.content: Have you realized that what you seek lies beyond your grasp?
Her expression reflects sympathy, yet her eyes gleam with satisfaction—everything unfolds precisely as she planned.
You no longer can bring yourself to argue against her words.

steps.speaker: Option
options: ...You said you wanted me to be your protagonist.

steps.speaker: %u
steps.content: If your goal was to rewrite Yingying's ending... then you've succeeded.

steps.speaker: %u
steps.content: But you didn't approach me just for this old story that's coming to an end, did you?

steps.speaker: %u
steps.content: For your next tale, do you already have something in mind?
She gazes at you, a smile gradually forming on her lips. Rising to her feet, she moves closer, then lifts your chin with the edge of her fan to peer deep into your eyes.

steps.speaker: Yugu
steps.content: Well then... that certainly calls for a proper discussion...
